Name: Decorative Clutter for Alternative Textures (AT)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img][/size]

[size=3]Random decorative clutter as recolours for Wood and Stone Signs - because [/size][i]too[/i][size=3] clean is too boring, right?[/size]

[size=3]Add some clutter to your room to make it look like someone actually lives there.[/size]

[size=3]Decorate your house and your farm with random objects that you can't get otherwise.[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/CzUFCQU.png[/img][/size]
[size=3] [/size]
[size=3]Or maybe you dream of opening up your own store?[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/yxrihXG.png[/img][/size]

[size=3]Your garden is so plant- and weedless it's [/size][i]boring[/i][size=3]?[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/DgoEqUY.jpg[/img][/size]


[size=3]Or maybe you have a project in mind that is a little... creepy?[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/kSyILt3.png[/img][/size]

[size=3]Lewis got lazy this year and asked you to organise the egg hunt?[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/n39hsqv.jpg[/img][/size]

[size=3]There are so many options![/size]

[size=5][b]NEW: 1.6 update includes books, rocks, ores, two more easter eggs and a pirate sign![/b]
[/size]
[b]Note[/b][size=3]: since these are recolours of the Wood and Stone Sign, you can still [/size][i]use them as a sign[/i][size=3], which may not always look nice.[/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/aMeFCvP.png[/img] [/size]


[size=3]... although in some situations, it's not a bug but a feature﻿![/size]

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/mee1D9D.png[/img] [/size]

[b]Suggestion[/b][size=3]: use this mod alongside [/size][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7482]Better Signs[/url][/b][size=3] for a better sign experience![/size]

[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img][/size]
[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img][/size]
[list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Download the .zip file and extract into your /Mods folder
[/size][/list][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_use.png[/img]

Just place a [b]Wood Sign[/b] or a [b]Stone Sign[/b] and recolour it using the [b]Paint Bucket [/b]from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod.

This mod is just a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], if the mod isn't properly working, please check with them first!

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_bugreports.png[/img]

If you have any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][b]-[/b]specific issues, please direct them to the devs on their respective mod page.﻿

Please report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_credits.png[/img]
﻿
Most of the sprites are from the game.
Assets edited and packaged for Alternative Textures by lydocia.
Please do not re-use or re-share anywhere without my permission.
